source_record.audit: France revision 4: exact Millennium Dawn research bonus API and eligible 1970-1990 targets
source_record.scope: Read-only source audit. MD source is the installed workshop tree, overlaid by local common/technologies files of the same filename and local custom technologies. No game files, concept JSON, generator, or viewer were changed.

api.confirmed: add_tech_bonus supports technology = <technology_id>; multiple technology entries are accepted in one block. For a deterministic named target use a separate one-target block with uses = 1. Native category = CAT_* is supported, but category members depend on the active technology definitions.

evidence.detail: One add_tech_bonus block lists nine exact technology IDs (body_armor_1..4 and camouflage_1..5).
technology = gen_5_medium with BBA, else technology = Strike_fighter4; both use bonus 0.30, uses 1.

Exact target branch bonus, with has_tech check to add a next-generation target when the first target is already researched. This demonstrates an explicit fallback pattern, not automatic engine fallback.

api.exhausted_targets: Source cannot establish engine behavior when a listed technology is already researched or when all eligible targets become unavailable. Native examples add explicit has_tech fallback branches. For fixed France rewards, grant one exact technology target per branch and only include a fallback if its condition is explicitly coded. Do not describe an unused bonus as moving automatically to another technology.

category_coverage.finding: The following 1970-1990 member counts were computed over the active source set (local same-name files replace the MD file; custom local files are added), deduplicated by technology ID. Category membership is demonstrably broad: these IDs include aircraft design, engines, avionics, refueling, drones and weapons; naval includes hulls plus radar/sonar, torpedoes, VLS, power systems and landing craft; armor includes ammo, engines, ERA and component upgrades. Prefer one direct technology ID where the focus is about a named programme.

source_record.calibration: Comparable native examples span +0.25 to +0.75 for one or two uses; direct model-specific bonuses use +0.30 to +0.55 for one use and can carry explicit funding cost. global_1970_special_project_audit.finding: France 1970 history contains no completion of aviation, naval-vessel, armored-vehicle, helicopter, or microchip projects; completions appear later in the 2000 history block. Active MD on_actions, common scripted_effects, decisions and events search found no generic global 1970 completion for these. This proves no generic startup grant, not permanent unreachability; project availability can depend on DLC/state and was not runtime-tested. Treat gated technologies as optional only with native has_dlc and completed-project guards.

source_record.bundle_usage_caveat: These are candidate IDs, not a runtime auto-selection contract. With uses=1 and one exact technology field, the grant is finite. Do not promise automatic reassignment if the technology is already researched or unavailable; source evidence does not establish exhausted-target engine behavior. Any fallback must be an explicit separate guarded add_tech_bonus branch with its own exact technology field. Gated candidate bonus eligibility must include the same DLC/project guards as its technology.

technology_gate_examples.nativeGuard: ROOT = { is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_helicopter_project }; legacy allow_branch = { NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" } }; NSB allow_branch = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }

project_and_dlc_gates.dlcBranchFinding: BBA_aircraft.txt tech blocks do not declare allow_branch or has_dlc in the active source; do not claim a native per-tech DLC branch guard. If the focus itself needs a BBA-only guard, source form is has_dlc = "By Blood Alone"; target itself additionally needs the native SP-completed check. NSB_armor.txt MBT/component/engine rows inspected have no allow_branch in active local definitions; do not invent one.
project_and_dlc_gates.projectReachability: These three project definitions are actively overridden locally and use allowed = { always = yes }, so the projects are available through the normal special-project interface, subject to player prerequisites/resources and runtime DLC/state; this does not mean France starts with them complete.

support_research_search.finding: No active tech ID for field_hospital, medical_support, engineer_company or equivalent field-medical support was found in local/installed MD technology source. mdcw_combat_engineer_vehicles_1968 is a verified engineering-support-related combat stats tech, but it does not unlock a field-hospital support company. Keep rescue electronics as microprocessors; do not re-label a grenade launcher as rescue.
